name: scandiweb-magento
description: Connect Claude to your own Magento 2 store and manage products, prices, stock, categories, CMS pages and blocks, media, and navigation through the Scandiweb Magento MCP modules.

store_mcp_url.title: Magento MCP endpoint
store_mcp_url.description: Full HTTPS address of your own store's MCP endpoint, normally https://your-store.com/mcp. The Scandiweb Magento MCP modules must already be installed on the store.
